result.prior_version_note: Per the SF Rent Board table, for eviction notices served 3/01/25 – 2/28/26 the payment for temporary displacement of less than 20 days was $436.00/day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses. The current rate is $446.00/day for notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27. The documents do not give the date § 1947.9 itself took effect.
